title: Menzel deletes Harvard observatory data

tellings.quote: and there's this amazing Swedish astronomer Beatatrice Valale and she talks about Menzel having like deleted like all this astronomical information from like 1953 and onwards in uh from the Harvard Observatory

related.note: Both are about Menzel and the 1953 break in Harvard Observatory sky data. This telling says he deleted the data, where the story says he stopped the survey.

plain: Starting in 1953, the astronomer Donald Menzel is said to have deleted a great deal of sky data from the Harvard Observatory. Jesse Michels brings this up from what he heard from the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, whom he calls Swedish. If true, it would mean records that might have shown unusual things in the sky were removed.
